sheet.div: Edited after the customer confirmed it. RS.GE reset the confirmation: the customer has to confirm it again. This note goes away when they do.

div.class: alert alert-warning rounded-1 mb-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between
div.span: Changed in Odoo, not yet on RS.GE. The delivery's operation type changed. Check the waybill, then save it.

div.class: alert alert-warning rounded-1 mb-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between
div.span: The vendor lowered this waybill after you received it: . Does the vendor still owe this?

div.class: alert alert-danger rounded-1 mb-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between
div.invisible: not rs_post_commit_error or rs_goods_pending_snapshot or context.get('edit_mode')
div.span:
Part of this waybill's work in Odoo did not complete.
It is retried automatically; fix the cause and click Retry to do it now.

div.class: alert alert-warning rounded-1 mb-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between
div.span:
An Adjustment was not sent to RS.GE.
Odoo shows your changes; RS.GE still has the waybill as it was.

button.name: action_discard_adjustment
button.confirm: Put the waybill back as it is on RS.GE? Your unsent changes are lost.

div.class: alert alert-danger rounded-1 mb-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between
div.span: A goods change made on RS.GE is not applied to the delivery. Nothing was changed.

div.class: alert alert-warning rounded-1 mb-2 d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between
div.span: Goods are no longer with the customer. They were lowered on this waybill or came back on a return. Say what happens with them and with the order.

sheet.div: Vendor changed goods on this waybill. Click Receive to apply the change to the PO and receipt, or Reject to decline.
Which delivery are these goods coming back from? Pick it so the sales order counts the return.
Which purchase order are these goods for? Several open orders of this vendor hold these products.
